beats.text: Part f. Suppose the powder absorbs moisture from the air before a new four point zero zero gram sample is weighed. Some of that four point zero zero grams is now water, so there's less X in the sample.
Less X dissolves, so less heat is released, the temperature rise is smaller, and the calculated percentage of X is lower. Two marks: the reduced active mass, and its effect on the result.
The full tally for Q twenty-eight: two, four, one, two, one and two, for twelve marks.
